scope: Read-only audit of the frozen MCRB derivation card, exact 5090 training sources and target-blind e1/e80 method state. This is not an e200 quality decision.

formula_to_code.claim: The moving defect is one half of the mean squared difference between current and one-epoch-EMA log directional covariance fields on the same current bridge state and common latent bundle.
formula_to_code.implementation: _mcrb_direction_covariance_defect constructs one latent list under RNG preservation, evaluates current and teacher on identical X_t/time/latents, computes log_direction_covariance and returns 0.5*difference.square().mean().

formula_to_code.claim: The constrained object is the exact displacement proposed by native Adam, not a raw gradient or auxiliary loss.
formula_to_code.implementation: _generator_optimizer_step stores pre-step parameters, calls the complete superclass generator optimizer step, and defines native displacement as post-Adam minus pre-Adam parameters.

formula_to_code.claim: Safe native displacement is identity; unsafe displacement is projected onto the tangent halfspace while native Adam moments are retained.
formula_to_code.implementation: project_actual_displacement returns the original tensor list for dot<=0 or numerically zero tangent. Only unsafe parameters are overwritten with old+projected after the native optimizer has already updated its state; optimizer state is never rewritten.

formula_to_code.claim: The temporal reference follows the committed candidate and self-nulls at a stable state.
formula_to_code.implementation: _update_mcrb_teacher runs after the projected/native displacement is committed with decay exp(-log(2)/150), updates floating state by EMA and copies nonfloating buffers.

formula_to_code.claim: The observation is target blind and does not change rollout, endpoint forward, inference, D, E or F updates.
formula_to_code.implementation: The mixin overrides only the generator optimizer-step hook, reads the already formed unpaired real_A_noisy/time state, uses no evaluation dataset or paired field, restores CPU/CUDA RNG, and delegates all native losses and other player steps.

formula_to_code.claim: EMA, counters and diagnostics are exactly resumable.
formula_to_code.implementation: get_extra_training_state and load_extra_training_state bind teacher weights, half-life, update/intervention counters, correction sum and last geometry; half-life mismatch fails closed.

declared_numeric_boundary.represented_float32_operator: adds 8*finfo(dtype).eps*max(1,abs(<a,d0>)) to the numerator before subtraction
declared_numeric_boundary.reason: prevent the represented float32 displacement from rounding back to the unsafe side
declared_numeric_boundary.consequence: The float32 result is a slightly interior feasible point rather than the literal boundary argmin; the derivation card already declares this dtype-derived feasibility margin.

target_blind_execution_snapshot.interpretation: The registered operator is materially active and has not accidentally collapsed to plain. Milestone diagnostics are descriptive target-blind state only; they do not authorize early stopping, code change or a PSNR claim.

remaining_scientific_question: Only the complete matched e200 trajectory can decide whether this mathematically faithful current implementation yields sustained quality benefit.
